label: N5860-48SC 10G/100G data-centre leaf switch
description: FS N5860-48SC 1U ToR leaf switch - 48x 10G SFP+ ports and 8x 100G QSFP28 uplinks, non-blocking, with VXLAN/EVPN, M-LAG, PFC/ECN and RDMA, redundant hot-swap PSUs. Managed over CLI, SNMP and NETCONF.
notes: The port list is the one filed with the request (48x 10G SFP+ and 8x 100G QSFP28), read by the reporter from FS's datasheet. It could not be re-verified here: FS's per-model datasheet URL 404s and its product pages do not serve text to a fetch, so the citation is the catalogue page the request itself names. What corroborates the shape is the family: the N8560-48BC datasheet in this catalogue (same 1U ToR platform, same 8x QSFP28 uplink block, MGMT + console) confirms the structure, and the switching capacity/customer-comparison sheet puts the N5860 in the same 4 Tbps class as the N8560. Ports carry their media (`sfp+1..48`, `qsfp28-1..8`) rather than a NOS name, for the same reason as its sibling.
